validity.researcher_notes: Pipeline verified to exist and operate. GS Southeast Expansion is an operating Gulf South/Boardwalk expansion from Mississippi to Alabama, completed in-service June 2008. EIA strongly matches all specs (111 mi, 42 in, 1272 MMcf/d capacity, $1.296B cost, Docket CP07-32). Route is 2-point line (very low accuracy) from approximately -90.08°W, 31.97°N (Mississippi) to -88.32°W, 32.15°N (Alabama), consistent with recorded MS->AL endpoints.

summary: P5926 GS Southeast Expansion is a confirmed operating pipeline, 111 mi MS->AL transmission line, in-service June 2008, capacity 1272 MMcf/d. All specs corroborated by EIA historical data (row 510, docket CP07-32). Second-source refs needed for StartYear, Capacity, Length, Diameter, SegmentCost, Location, Operator. Construction year, Pressure, FuelSource unresolved.
